["FIRST"] This is meant to be a line Giga Belial can say if Baby Belial has just showed the transformation sequence. This is called "FIRST" because this only happens when the player has not yet tried to re-try or resummon Giga Belial on farming runs.

We will need to use a Condition to control if we play a "FIRST" or "SUBSEQUENT" spawn line.

["SUBSEQUENT"] This is meant to be a line Giga Belial can say if the arena is already transformed when he's spawned. This happens when a player is farming the endgame boss ladder and has just defeated Giga Belial and is summoning him again. 

We will need to use a Condition to control if we play a "FIRST" or "SUBSEQUENT" spawn line.
